dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: Hmm... Oh! Hello. Can I help you with something?

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: This is where new prisoners are registered... One of them, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: I don't think I was notified that any new prisoners would be coming... If you've come to the wrong place, please go back the way you came or ask one of the nearby guards for assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. I remember you, and your little friend as well. You're the ones the Iudex personally had escorted over here. You don't see that every day.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: Okay... Your registration information is all squared away. Try not to make any waves until you complete your sentence, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. I remember you, and your little friend as well. You're the ones the Iudex personally had escorted over here. You don't see that every day.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: Let's see here... Your files have been updated. Congratulations, consider your sentence officially served. You're free to go back to a place where the sun shines brightly and live your life as you see fit.
